description: This file defines the trait 'FileScan' which is part of Apache Spark's data source V2 API. It provides an interface for scanning files, including methods for schema handling, partitioning, filtering, and statistics estimation, used in Spark SQL data source implementations.

classes.name: FileScan
classes.description: A trait in Spark SQL's data source V2 API that provides methods for scanning files, including schema management, filtering, partitioning, and statistics estimation.

methods.name: isSplitable
methods.description: Determines if a file at the given path can be split into multiple parts.

methods.name: getFileUnSplittableReason
methods.description: Returns the reason why a file is not splittable, asserting that the file is indeed not splittable.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Provides a string description of the scan, including metadata.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Returns metadata about the scan, such as format, schema, filters, and location.

methods.name: partitions
methods.description: Computes and returns the sequence of file partitions to be processed.

methods.name: planInputPartitions
methods.description: Returns the array of input partitions for execution.

methods.name: estimateStatistics
methods.description: Estimates the size and number of rows for the scan.

methods.name: toBatch
methods.description: Returns the batch representation of the scan.

methods.name: readSchema
methods.description: Returns the combined schema of data and partition fields.

methods.name: equivalentFilters
methods.description: Checks if two filter arrays are equivalent.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Normalizes a column name based on case sensitivity settings.
